lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.1 (mt funext_iff.mpr hne)
  have hi : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have h0 : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (fun h => hx0 (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hpos⟩ : ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ, 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hi.continuousAt h0)
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  let u : Y → ℝ := fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  profile_tactic "cd" in have c1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ⇑φ := φ.contDiff
  profile_tactic "hcs" in have c2 : HasCompactSupport ⇑φ := φ.hasCompactSupport
  profile_tactic "cc" in have c3 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : Y => f x₀) := contDiff_const
  profile_tactic "tf" in
    have htf : IsTestFunction (fun x => φ x • f x₀) := IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨c1, c2⟩ c3
  profile_tactic "spec0" in have hspec0 := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀) htf
  profile_tactic "spec1" in
    have hspec1 : ∫ x, ⟪f x, φ x • f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0 := hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀) htf
  profile_tactic "bridge" in
    have hI : ∫ x, u x ∂μ = 0 := by simpa only [u, inner_smul_right'] using hspec1
  profile_tactic "tf2" in
    have htf2 : IsTestFunction (fun x => φ x • f x₀) :=
      ⟨φ.contDiff.smul_right contDiff_const, φ.hasCompactSupport.smul_right⟩
  profile_tactic "mk" in
    have htf3 : IsTestFunction (fun x => φ x • f x₀) :=
      IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const
  exact (ne_of_gt (integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero (φ.continuous.mul hi)
      ((φ.continuous.mul hi).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (φ.hasCompactSupport.mono (Function.support_mul_subset_left _ _)))
      (fun x => if h : φ x = 0 then by simp [h]
        else mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hpos x (le_of_eq φ.support_eq (Function.mem_support.mpr h))).le)
      (mul_ne_zero (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)).ne' h0.ne'))) hI
